text: Handling deadlines successfully requires good planning and clear communication. First, time management is essential: create a schedule and break large tasks into smaller steps. Prioritization helps you focus on the most important work first, so you spend your energy wisely. Scope management is also important, because trying to do too much can cause delays. Be realistic about what you can finish and agree on clear goals with your team. Finally, communicate openly. If a problem appears, tell others early instead of waiting until the last minute. With these habits, you can meet deadlines with less stress and produce better results.
